$comment: Golden set for the KnowledgeOS design document (docs/KnowledgeOS_AI_TDD.pdf).
GROUND TRUTH IS LEXICAL, NOT RETRIEVED. Each answerable question names a
distinctive phrase that appears verbatim in the source document. The harness
resolves relevant chunk ids by exact substring match in Postgres — never by
running the retriever. Labelling with the system under test would make every
metric circular and guarantee a perfect score.
The corpus is a real document and the questions are ones a reader of it would
actually ask. No fabricated documents, no model-generated question/answer
pairs: a golden set written by a model measures agreement with that model, and
would score highest exactly where the system shares its blind spots.
